audit.whatIsWrong: early says Wukong has 'no W clone, no E dash' pre-6, which reads as though those abilities unlock at 6.
audit.why: Warrior Trickster and Nimbus Strike are ordinary skill points available from level 2 onward; what is actually true is that a Q-first Wukong has not banked points in them for the first two or three levels. Level 6 is Cyclone, nothing else.
audit.corrected: Tie the window to his skill points, not to level 6.

audit.why: Spikes at 2-3 (Acceleration Gate), 6 (Cyclone, 130s at rank 1), first item (his armour/regen soaking the orb) and 2+ items are correctly placed; the level chart hands him nothing before 6 and evens out after, matching a 50.12% matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow is never identified as an auto-attack reset, so the page tells you to watch 'which body casts' but not what the actual burst tell is.
audit.why: Riot kit: Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset (6s maxed). The wind-up on the attack is the cue to step out, not the ability cast — by the time you see the cast the shred has landed. Nimbus Strike is 10s at rank 1 and 7s maxed, and Warrior Trickster 22s at rank 1, so a spent clone is a long honest window.
audit.corrected: State the reset tell plus the 10s / 22s numbers.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your window: take Cannon Q and gate-Q (Shock Blast fired through your Acceleration Gate) every time Wukong steps up to last-hit, because pre-6 he has no W clone, no E dash and only his Crushing Blow (Q) armor-shred — so he just eats the accelerated orb. When he commits, open Cannon Q, swap to Hammer for the Armor/MR shred, then To the Skies into Thundering Blow to knock him off you. Don't chase him into the wave burning his E; bank the health lead and the plates instead, since his passive (bonus resists and regen near enemies) heals back chip the moment you stop poking.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your window: take Cannon Q and gate-Q (Shock Blast fired through your Acceleration Gate) every time Wukong steps up to last-hit, because until he banks points in W and E he has no clone and no dash — only his Crushing Blow (Q) armor-shred — so he just eats the accelerated orb. When he commits, open Cannon Q, swap to Hammer for the Armor/MR shred, then To the Skies! into Thundering Blow to knock him off you. Don't chase him into the wave burning his E; bank the health lead and the plates instead, since his passive (bonus resists and regen near enemies) heals back chip the moment you stop poking.
